channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Axios founders discuss AI's impact on inboxes and lessons from the '90s
item.description: Jim VandeHei, Mike Allen and Roy Schwartz argue that technology meant to save time has had the opposite effect. Their book addresses how to "Simplify."

item.title: College sports still disadvantage student athletes despite NIL era
item.description: Without collective bargaining agreements as in professional sports, college athletes must navigate NIL without clear guidance.

item.title: Law firm billed clients $600 hourly for Harvard graduate's data entry work
item.description: Artificial intelligence is reshaping the distribution of talent and availability of resources in the industry, whether it welcomes the change or not.

item.title: 71-year-old former radiologist and professor now runs banana-skewer business
item.description: Richard Brown has moved from medicine to academia to business. At 71, he remains active and focused on entrepreneurship.
